alpine-ski.label: Alpine Ski
alpine-ski.rationale: Iconic: crouched skier with poles on fixed-heel skis, the pictogram for downhill.

snowboard.label: Snowboard
snowboard.rationale: Iconic: rider sideways on a single board; the board silhouette separates it from two-ski figures.

nordic-classic.label: Nordic Classic
nordic-classic.rationale: Iconic/indexical: upright striding figure with poles, the kick-and-glide pole gait; no ski or crouch, so it differs from alpine.

nordic-skate.label: Nordic Skate
nordic-skate.rationale: Indexical: skate boot with blade stands for the skating stride; distinct footwear-only silhouette.

snowshoe.label: Snowshoe
snowshoe.rationale: Iconic: walker with oversized snowshoe flotation.

fat-bike.label: Fat Bike
fat-bike.rationale: Iconic: bare bicycle, riderless, distinguished from the rider figure used for mountain bike.

mountain-bike.label: Mountain Bike
mountain-bike.rationale: Iconic: rider on a bike, the standard cycling pictogram.

hike.label: Hike
hike.rationale: Iconic: walker with pack and trekking pole.

tubing.label: Tubing
tubing.rationale: Iconic/indexical: figure riding a sled down a slope, nearest sliding-on-snow sign.

adaptive.label: Adaptive
adaptive.rationale: Symbolic: ISA wheelchair user, the learned sign for accessible; forward-leaning variant is the dynamic reading.

lift-ride.label: Lift Ride
lift-ride.rationale: Iconic: gondola cabin hanging from a cable.

winter.label: Winter
winter.rationale: Iconic: snowflake, the unambiguous winter sign; chosen over ac_unit which reads as air conditioning.

spring.label: Spring
spring.rationale: Symbolic: blossom, the conventional sign of spring; round-petalled silhouette.

summer.label: Summer
summer.rationale: Iconic: sun with rays, radial silhouette.

fall.label: Fall
fall.rationale: Iconic: single leaf; asymmetric leaf shape differs from the radial sun and snowflake.

imagery.label: Imagery
imagery.rationale: Indexical: satellite is the source of aerial photography.

buildings.label: Buildings
buildings.rationale: Iconic: tall block with windows stands for extruded footprints.

surface.label: Surface
surface.rationale: Iconic: trees stand for the canopy; roofs are covered by the buildings icon and the label.

trees.label: Trees
trees.rationale: Iconic: a round-crowned tree on a trunk, the simulated individual trees; distinct from the forest glyph that stands for the LiDAR canopy surface.

terrain-exaggeration.label: Terrain
terrain-exaggeration.rationale: Indexical: vertical arrows with bars signal stretching along the vertical axis.

resort.label: Resort
resort.rationale: Symbolic: person-on-pin is the Street View convention for eye-level viewpoint.

overview.label: Overview
overview.rationale: Iconic: mountain range stands for the whole terrain seen from above at an angle.

top-down.label: Top Down
top-down.rationale: Symbolic: folded map is the convention for plan view.

clear-filters.label: Clear Filters
clear-filters.rationale: Symbolic: funnel with a slash, the convention for removing filters.

group-activity.label: Activity
group-activity.rationale: Symbolic: whistle for organised activity; avoids reusing any single activity glyph.

group-season.label: Season
group-season.rationale: Symbolic: calendar for time of year.

group-layers.label: Layers
group-layers.rationale: Iconic: stacked sheets, the layers convention.

track-start.label: Start
track-start.rationale: Iconic: a flag planted at the start of a track.

track-end.label: End
track-end.rationale: Iconic: chequered finish flag, the end of a track.
